Landing Page · Web Ordering Experience

Food Hut — Restaurant Landing & Ordering Flow

A warm, appetite-driven landing page and end-to-end ordering experience for Food Hut, an online food vendor based in Lagos, Nigeria. The site lets regular customers create an account, save their favourite meals and pay — turning a hungry visitor into a completed order with as little friction as possible.

Role

End-to-end UI/UX Designer

Type

Landing Page & Web App

Tools

Figma

Focus

Conversion & Checkout

  • A hero that funnels first-time visitors toward a single, unmistakable primary action.
  • Smart filtering that lets hungry users cut through a large menu to their craving in seconds.
  • A low-friction return journey that welcomes customers back mid-order rather than resetting them.
  • A guided, multi-step checkout that keeps costs transparent at every stage to reduce drop-off.
  • A food-forward visual language engineered to build appetite and signal trust.
  • A reusable component library that keeps the experience uniform and speeds future iteration.

02
Academic Research · Graduate Capstone · Mobile App

Old Ibadan — Heritage & Virtual Tour App

A self-initiated, end-to-end proof of concept I conceived, researched and designed from scratch as my graduate studies capstone project. Old Ibadan reimagines how residents, tourists and students explore the historical sites of Ibadan, Nigeria — pairing an interactive digital map with immersive Virtual Reality tours so heritage can be discovered on-site or from anywhere in the world.

An original idea, taken from concept to validated design. I owned the entire process as sole researcher and designer — grounding every decision in primary UX research rather than assumption. To do this authentically, I conducted interviews and questionnaires with residents of Ibadan and local historians, ensuring the product was rooted in lived experience and historically accurate storytelling.

Role

Sole Researcher & UX/UI Designer

Type

Graduate Capstone · Proof of Concept

Tools

Figma · Survey & Interview Kits

Methods

Mixed-Methods UX Research

A Rigorous, User-Centered Process

01 · Discover
Primary Research

Structured interviews and questionnaires with Ibadan residents and historians to understand needs, mental models and the cultural narrative worth preserving.

02 · Define
Synthesis & UX Writing

Combined qualitative themes with quantitative survey data to shape information architecture and craft accurate, resonant UX copy for each heritage site.

03 · Design
Wireframes → Hi-Fi

Progressed from lo-fi paper wireframes to a polished, high-fidelity system centred on the interactive digital map and immersive virtual-tour experience.

04 · Validate
A/B Testing

Ran A/B tests on competing layouts and flows, letting real user preference — not opinion — drive the final design decisions.

  • Rooted in primary research — interviews & questionnaires with Ibadan residents and historians.
  • Mixed-methods analysis — qualitative and quantitative data informing IA and UX writing.
  • Evidence-based decisions — A/B testing used to resolve design trade-offs objectively.
  • Interactive digital map that turns the city itself into a navigable, discoverable archive.
  • Immersive virtual reality tours that let users experience heritage remotely, as if standing before it.
  • Full journey from lo-fi wireframes to a documented, hi-fi design system built from scratch.

Web Page · Responsive Redesign

UofA Blueprint — Website Redesign

A responsive website redesign for University of Alberta Blueprint, a student group that builds software for nonprofits pro bono. I reshaped the site's information architecture and visual system so two very different audiences — students hoping to join and nonprofits seeking help — could each find their own path and grasp the club's mission at a glance.

Role

Web / UI Designer

Type

Responsive Website

Tools

Figma

Live

uofablueprint.com

  • An information architecture that untangles two distinct audience journeys into clear, parallel paths.
  • Transparent onboarding that sets expectations up front for prospective members and partners alike.
  • A values framework translated into a scannable format, making the club's principles easy to absorb.
  • A structured way to spotlight the people behind the work and build organisational credibility.
  • A cohesive layout and component system that holds up consistently across every breakpoint.
  • Delivered collaboratively inside a multi-disciplinary student team.

Mobile App · Fintech

O2 HUB — Instant Loans & Bill Payments

O2 HUB is a fintech mobile solution designed for modern, on-the-go financial management. It simplifies the digital borrowing process — letting users request instant loans online exactly when they need them — while seamlessly integrating everyday utility and bill payments into a single, unified interface.

Role

UI/UX Designer

Type

Fintech Mobile App

Tools

Figma

Focus

Loans & Bill Payments

  • A borrowing experience designed to feel instant, stripping out the paperwork that gates traditional credit.
  • Everyday bills and top-ups folded into one place, so users manage money without app-switching.
  • A guided onboarding that carries first-time users from install to their first request in minutes.
  • Reassurance engineered into every confirmation, using clear feedback to earn trust around money movement.
  • A dashboard that surfaces the most decision-relevant information first, for at-a-glance awareness.
  • A unified component system that keeps the whole experience calm and predictable.

Type

Tools

Focus

Fintech & Investing

  • A native mobile companion that makes putting money to work a quick, on-the-go habit.
  • Decisions grounded in real user research and iterative feedback rather than assumption.
  • Saving rhythms that flex to meet people where their real income patterns are.
  • A forward-looking roadmap that anticipates richer planning tools as users grow.
